title: Add unit tests for math operations
prompt: `src/math.js` exports `add`, `multiply` and `average` but ships no tests. Create `test/math.test.mjs` that asserts the real behaviour of all three, including the empty-array case for `average`, and exits non-zero on any failure. It must run with `node test/math.test.mjs`. Do not modify `src/math.js`.
